caption:
I rewatched this the other day after seeing it for the first time in 2020 and holy cow I forgot how mind blowing it is. David Wilcock and the others in the documentary do such a great job of articulating the “why” as to everything that is going on in the world. A highly recommended watch for anyone who is starting to wake up. 

Search “Above Majestic” or go to my Linktree on my page to watch, I’d love to hear feedback if you guys want to come back and comment or start a convo in the TG chat t.me/outoforderchat

video_overlay_text_observed: Cover card: "David Wilcock said too much 😊".
audio_content_summary: Creator (Morgan Marshall) reacts to a clip from David Wilcock's 2018 documentary 'Above Majestic,' says Wilcock 'passed away recently' and asserts she believes 'people in power are silencing the whistleblowers.' The embedded Wilcock clip: a 'hidden elite' practicing corruption, rape, pedophilia, child trafficking, human sacrifice, and cannibalism as 'religious sacrament,' advertising itself through symbols in movies, video games, TV, music videos, and awards ceremonies. The clip closes on Ronald Reagan's 1987 UN 'alien threat' line ('is not an alien force already among us?').
implied_frame: Frames David Wilcock's death as the silencing of a whistleblower who 'knew too much.' Recorded as 2026-wilcock-death-above-majestic-001. Verified: Wilcock did die April 20, 2026 at 53 — but the contemporaneous account is suicide (a 911 call he placed, responding officers present at the scene, family citing depression and financial debt), which cuts against the 'murdered to silence him' inference; that inference is attributed and contested. Wilcock's 'Above Majestic' quotes are preserved verbatim as primary sources at the operator's request (for a 'dead whistleblowers' piece); his hidden-elite/cannibalism/media-symbols claims are his contested assertions, not adopted. The clip's closing 'alien threat' lines are Ronald Reagan's 1987 UN address quoted in the film — attributed to Reagan, not Wilcock.
capture_method: Pristine original media + metadata pulled from Instagram's CDN via yt-dlp; delivery webm derived once (VP9 video copied, audio normalized to -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP off the source AAC — no re-recording, no in-place re-encode).
